alt: A group seated on mats in a semicircle facing a woman on a chair holding papers
subject: A group sits on mats in a semicircle on a pale tiled floor facing a woman seated on a folding chair with papers on her lap, in a room with a yellow wall and blue curtains.
qualityNotes: The only real 'discussion' composition on this sheet, and it reads clearly: seated circle, one person presenting, papers in hand. Landscape, sharp. A figure is cut at the right edge and there is a lot of empty floor in the foreground. A child stands with the adults at the left of the group.

alt: Four people in a line folding forward with their hands on the backs of folding chairs
subject: A woman in a black t-shirt and patterned leggings folds forward with both hands on the back of a folding chair, three other practitioners doing the same in a receding line behind her.
qualityNotes: The clearest 'whole class doing one thing' frame in the Prabhava set: four bodies in the same shape stepping back into depth, all sharp. Warm cast and a slightly cluttered doorway at the far end.

alt: A woman and a man working with folding chairs in front of an arched window with blue curtains
subject: A woman in a white t-shirt stands in a wide stance beside a man in grey, both working with folding chairs, in front of an arched window with blue curtains and prop shelves.
qualityNotes: Sharpest frame on the sheet, with real daylight through the arched window and two clearly separated figures. A red bag on the floor at the right and a dark chair frame across the bottom left are the main flaws.

alt: Two people folding forward with their hands on wooden blocks against a yellow wall
subject: A woman in a coral top folds forward with both hands on wooden blocks on a dark mat, a second practitioner in white doing the same beside her against a yellow wall.
qualityNotes: The tightest and most graphic frame of this run - two bodies folded into near-identical shapes, hands on blocks, against a warm plain wall. Faces are hidden. A chair leg and a white cloth intrude at the left.

alt: Two people lying back over folding chairs with knees bent and feet on the frames
subject: Two people lie back over folding chairs with knees bent and feet on the chair frames, blocks and a bolster beside them, a wooden door and pink wall behind.
qualityNotes: Sharp and well exposed with two bodies in a clear supported backbend. Faces are obscured by the chairs. The bright pink wall panel at the top is a loud, dating colour.

alt: Three women lying in a row with knees open, belts around their feet and bolsters under their heads
subject: Three women lie on their backs in a row with knees open, belts around their feet and bolsters under their heads, along a pale-floored hall.
qualityNotes: The row of three makes the repetition read as a taught class rather than an individual. Sharp, warm daylight. All three faces are identifiable and the pink wall is still there.

alt: An earth path running away between dense green trees and clipped lawn into shade
subject: An earth path runs away between dense green trees and clipped lawn, disappearing into shade at the far end.
qualityNotes: The strongest atmospheric frame in the archive: a clean receding path, no people, no signage, deep green on both sides and a bright opening at the end. Highlights in the sky through the canopy are blown, and the greens are slightly yellow.

alt: An open-sided pavilion with a red tiled roof at the end of a red paved approach, framed by flowering creeper
subject: An open-sided pavilion with a red tiled roof and a decorated tile frieze stands at the end of a red paved approach, framed by a pergola hung with orange flowering creeper.
qualityNotes: The single best architectural frame in the archive: a clear symmetrical approach, a distinctive tiled pavilion, and flowering creeper framing the top. Sharp. The sky is blown white and the red paving is a strong colour that will dominate any page it sits on.

alt: Five practitioners standing in warrior one with arms raised on mats across a red floor
subject: Five practitioners stand in warrior one with arms raised overhead on mats spread across a red oxide floor in an open-sided hall, rope anchors hanging from the roof beams behind.
qualityNotes: A whole class in one raised-arm shape across a warm red floor, with the hanging ropes giving the room character. Nobody's face is readable. The white walls are slightly blown at the right and the foreground floor is a large empty red area.

alt: A large seated group of women in saris listening to two men seated on chairs
subject: A large seated group of women in saris listens to two men seated on chairs at the left, in a wide hall with green netting and a curtained window.
qualityNotes: The clearest 'faculty addressing a cohort' frame in the archive, and the sari colours give the group real warmth against the red floor. Bright, slightly flat light; everyone identifiable.

alt: An empty hall with four folding chairs in a row, each beside a mat with a blanket, bolster and block
subject: An empty hall with four folding chairs set out in a row on a red oxide floor, each beside a mat with a folded blanket, a bolster and a wooden block, daylight from an open side at the right.
qualityNotes: A room prepared and waiting - one of the few genuinely quiet, unpeopled interiors in the archive and an obvious candidate for a section opener. Sharp, with a strong receding rhythm of chairs. The red floor is a dominant colour and the right-hand doorway is blown out.

alt: Women in saris seated on a red floor watching a woman speaking, two people on chairs beside her
subject: Women in saris sit on the red floor of a wide open-sided hall watching a woman standing at the left, with two people seated on chairs beside her and green shade netting across the far side.
qualityNotes: A clear teaching arrangement with a speaker, faculty and a seated cohort, and the corrugated roof gives the hall real character. The green netting is a loud flat colour and most of the group has its back to the camera.

alt: Four people in supported headstand over folding chairs in a row along a white wall
subject: Four people hold supported headstand over folding chairs in a row along a white wall, legs vertical, with blocks and blankets on the red floor.
qualityNotes: Four verticals in a row against a plain wall, with the heads hidden in the chairs so no one is identifiable - the most publishable inversion frame in the archive. Rope anchors visible in the roof. The wall is grey and slightly grubby.

alt: Four practitioners in supported bridge over chairs with a rope hanging from the roof beam
subject: Four practitioners in supported bridge over chairs along the red floor, with a rope hanging from the roof beam at the left and green netting behind.
qualityNotes: The most complete version of the restorative row: full length visible, hanging rope giving the hall character, and plenty of clean wall above. Faces still identifiable.

alt: A group seated in a circle on chairs inside an open-sided pavilion looking out onto a lawn and trees
subject: A group sits in a circle on plastic and wooden chairs inside an open-sided pavilion with a tiled roof and square columns, looking out onto a lawn and trees; a man in a green shirt sits at the centre of the far side.
qualityNotes: The best study-and-discussion composition in the archive: a real circle, an open pavilion, green outside, and warm wooden floor. The exposure is a compromise between the shaded interior and the bright lawn, so the outside is close to blowing. Backs of heads in the foreground.

alt: A broad earth path running between kerbed lawns and tall slender trees
subject: A broad earth path runs between kerbed lawns and tall slender trees, with buildings just visible at the far end.
qualityNotes: Calm, symmetrical and completely unpeopled, with even overcast-style light and no blown sky - technically the cleanest of the campus path frames. The warm earth colour dominates the lower half.

alt: Five women holding tree pose with palms joined overhead on a concrete apron outside a building
subject: Five women hold tree pose with palms joined overhead on a concrete apron outside a low building, trees and a green wall behind.
qualityNotes: Five matched figures in one clear shape outdoors - rare in this archive, which is overwhelmingly indoor. The background is cluttered with a green building and a stack of pipes, and the concrete is a dull grey.

alt: Four women posing beneath a banyan in side bends and with arms raised, one seated with palms joined
subject: Four women pose beneath the banyan, two bending sideways with arms overhead, one standing with arms crossed above her head and one seated with palms joined.
qualityNotes: The most balanced of the four group arrangements - the shapes echo each other and the tree frames them well. Still unmistakably posed.

alt: Five women sitting cross-legged on grass among tall trees with their hands on their knees
subject: Five women sit cross-legged on grass among tall trees with their hands resting on their knees and eyes closed, a green hedge and buildings beyond.
qualityNotes: Calm, unposed, genuinely still - five people sitting quietly on grass under trees. Soft even light with no blown sky. A black hose snakes across the grass in the mid-ground and would need retouching or cropping.

alt: Four women sitting cross-legged in a staggered line on grass among tall trees
subject: Four women sit cross-legged on grass in a staggered line among tall trees, hands resting on their knees.
qualityNotes: Sharpest frame of the run, with good separation between the figures and a clean run of trunks behind. The bright sky at the top right is blown.

alt: Five practitioners in downward-facing dog on mats in a receding line, low sunlight across a red floor
subject: Five practitioners hold downward-facing dog on mats in a receding line in an open-sided hall, low sunlight across the red floor and green fields beyond the opening.
qualityNotes: The best of the three: five bodies in one recognisable shape, evenly spaced, with warm low light and a glimpse of green outside. No faces readable, no branding. Slight softness and the right edge cuts the last figure.

alt: A long row of people in supported shoulderstand seen low along a hall floor
subject: A long line of supported shoulderstands down a hall, with blankets, blocks and a pale tiled floor, seen from a low angle.
qualityNotes: The low angle turns the row into a graphic rhythm of verticals and nobody's face is readable, which makes it the safest of the run to publish. Shoes intrude at the bottom edge and the top third is plain ceiling.

alt: A woman with legs vertical and toes pointed beside a wall of practice ropes
subject: The same practitioner with legs vertical and toes pointed, framed closer against the rope wall with a framed picture above.
qualityNotes: Tighter and better balanced than cell 7, with the ropes reading clearly. Still a blue block and a white towel in the lower foreground and a slightly muddy yellow cast.

alt: Four people kneeling with palms joined in a room with a yellow wall and curtained window
subject: Four people kneel on mats with palms joined, in a room with a yellow wall, a curtained window and shelving of stacked props behind.
qualityNotes: Cleaner than cell 3 - no foreground obstruction - but the group is small in the frame and spread thinly across it, and the floor reflection is distracting. Faces fully identifiable.

alt: Three people folding forward over folding chairs in a receding line
subject: Three practitioners fold forward over folding chairs in a receding line, the nearest in a black t-shirt and checked leggings, with a bright doorway behind.
qualityNotes: Tight, well-spaced version of the same idea with good light falling down the line. Fewer bodies than cell 13, so less of the class feeling. Pair of shoes visible on the floor at the right.

alt: A woman folding forward over a chair with a block under her back foot beside a wall of ropes
subject: A woman in a black vest and leggings folds forward over a chair with a block under her back foot, in front of a yellow wall hung with practice ropes.
qualityNotes: Stronger than cell 10: the figure is larger, the rope wall reads clearly, and the warm yellow gives it some atmosphere. A second practitioner is partly cut at the left and a shoe sits on the floor at the bottom.

alt: A person holding a handstand against a yellow wall while a man steadies another person's legs
subject: A person in a teal t-shirt holds a handstand against a yellow wall while a man in a patterned shirt stands beside them steadying a second person's legs.
qualityNotes: The only wall handstand in the archive and a genuine supported-inversion teaching moment, but the framing is wide and loose, the figures small, and a bag and cloth are dumped in the mid-ground.

alt: Five people sitting on chairs and the floor in a loose circle talking, green netting behind them
subject: Five people sit on folding chairs and on the floor in a loose circle on a red oxide floor, talking, with green shade netting and trees behind them.
qualityNotes: A genuine informal discussion - people leaning in, phones and notes in hand, nobody looking at the camera. The green netting behind is a strong flat colour that will fight most palettes, and a black garment hangs in the left foreground.

alt: Five practitioners bending forward over folding chairs in a staggered line
subject: The same five practitioners bend forward over their chairs in a staggered line across the red floor.
qualityNotes: Better synchronised than cell 6 and the receding line is clearer. Same hard sunlight patches and identifiable faces.

alt: A woman in an orange t-shirt holding a low lunge beside a folding chair on a red floor
subject: A woman in an orange t-shirt holds a low lunge on a mat with a folding chair beside her while others work with chairs behind, on a red oxide floor.
qualityNotes: The orange top separates her clearly from the red floor, but the group behind is scattered and out of sync and a stack of blue bolsters clutters the left. Green netting is a strong colour note.

alt: A person arching backwards over a folding chair with hands and feet on the mat
subject: A person arches backwards over a folding chair with hands and feet on the mat in a deep backbend, a second practitioner working on a chair behind, on a red floor.
qualityNotes: A genuinely striking shape - the body making a full arch over the chair frame - and no face is readable. Stack of blue bolsters at the left is untidy and the surrounding floor is a large flat red expanse.

alt: Four women in saris kneeling with their backs to the camera facing a whiteboard on an easel
subject: Four women in saris kneel and sit close together on the red floor with their backs to the camera, facing a whiteboard on an easel at the right.
qualityNotes: Nobody's face is visible, which makes it easy to publish, and the sari colours are attractive against the red. But the composition is loose, a wooden stick lies on the floor, and a large area of bare red floor fills the right.

alt: Four practitioners in supported shoulderstand over chairs with blocks beside their heads
subject: Four practitioners in supported shoulderstand over chairs, the nearest with legs vertical in dark leggings, blocks beside their heads on a red floor.
qualityNotes: Tightest of the inversion run - the nearest figure is large enough to read clearly while the line still recedes. Sharp. Green netting and identifiable faces as before.

alt: Four practitioners lying back over bolsters with their legs resting on chair seats
subject: Four practitioners lie back over bolsters with their legs resting on chair seats, arms out along the mats, in a line on a red floor.
qualityNotes: The restorative end of the sequence - bodies at rest rather than held up, which gives it a completely different mood from the rest of the run. Sharp and warm. Faces visible; green netting at the top.

alt: A discussion circle of people on chairs in an open pavilion, one man leaning forward speaking
subject: A discussion circle of about eight people on chairs in the open pavilion, one man leaning forward speaking, another with a laptop bag at his feet, greenery beyond the columns.
qualityNotes: Closer than cell 5 and someone is clearly speaking, so the frame has a subject. A framed picture on the wall at the left and a chair back in the foreground are minor distractions. Everyone identifiable.

alt: Two women in tree pose with arms overhead beside a bamboo clump above dry fields
subject: Two women hold tree pose with arms overhead beside a bamboo clump, open dry fields and a low red wall behind them.
qualityNotes: Sharpest of the outdoor tree-pose frames, with the bamboo giving the left side structure. Both subjects are again looking at the lens and one is laughing. Background fields are washed out.

alt: Three women holding a standing balance on one leg with the other foot held behind them
subject: Three women hold a standing balance on one leg with the other foot held behind them, arms extended forward, on a concrete apron with bamboo and a low red wall behind.
qualityNotes: Three matched balances is a genuinely dynamic shape, and the bamboo behind gives it structure. The red wall is a heavy horizontal and the concrete is dull; the bright sky at the left is blown.

alt: A woman balancing on her hands on a large boulder among trees
subject: A woman in a blue vest balances in an arm balance on a large boulder among trees, with a painted building behind.
qualityNotes: An arm balance on a boulder is a striking, unusual image. Undercut by the painted building and a line of pipes behind, and the figure is small in the frame.

alt: Three women sitting cross-legged on grass with one arm raised and bent over the head
subject: Three women sit cross-legged on grass with one arm raised and bent over the head in a seated side stretch, under trees.
qualityNotes: Movement after stillness - the same group now stretching, which makes a natural pair with the seated frames. Two of the three are smiling at the camera. Hose still visible on the grass.

alt: Three women holding balancing poses against an exposed brick wall
subject: Three women hold balancing poses against an exposed brick wall - two in tree pose with palms overhead and one holding a raised leg out in front.
qualityNotes: The patterned brick wall is a genuinely good backdrop and the three shapes complement each other. Held back by flat light, a dull concrete plinth and the fact that all three are posing squarely for the camera.

alt: A woman hanging inverted from a rope while three people support and steady her
subject: A woman hangs inverted from a rope with her legs vertical while a man and two women support and steady her, on a red floor.
qualityNotes: Three people physically supporting one - a strong illustration of assisted practice - but the bodies overlap confusingly and the background is a jumble of chairs, curtains and stacked bolsters.

alt: Three women hanging inverted from wall ropes with legs spread wide, hands on the floor
subject: Three women hang inverted from wall ropes with legs spread in a wide V, hands on the red floor, folding chairs behind them.
qualityNotes: Sharpest of the rope inversions and the wide V shapes are clean and symmetrical. Green netting at the top left; all three faces are inverted but identifiable.

alt: An accommodation block seen past a large tree trunk with more buildings receding along a sandy path
subject: The same accommodation block seen past a large tree trunk in the foreground, with more buildings receding along a sandy path.
qualityNotes: The foreground trunk gives depth that cell 7 lacks, and the receding buildings show the scale of the campus. Flat overcast light; the ground is a wide expanse of bare sand.

alt: Five practitioners standing with arms raised overhead in an open-sided hall, low light across the floor
subject: Five practitioners stand on mats with their arms raised overhead in an open-sided hall, low sunlight raking across the red floor from the open side.
qualityNotes: The raking light across the floor is the best light in the archive - long shadows, warm glow off the red oxide. Held back by softness and by the row of figures being cut at the right edge. Faces are small and not readable.

alt: A person folding forward from standing with both hands on the back of a folding chair
subject: A person in a green top and grey trousers folds forward from standing with both hands resting on the back of a folding chair, other practitioners doing the same down the line behind.
qualityNotes: Excellent clean profile of a chair-supported forward bend, sharp, with the body making a clear horizontal line. The subject's face is hidden so nobody is identifiable. A red water bottle sits in the mid-ground and a navy bolster fills the bottom right corner.

alt: A man reaching out to adjust the back of a woman folding forward over a folding chair
subject: A woman in a blue t-shirt folds forward with both hands pressing the seat of a folding chair while a man in a checked shirt reaches out to adjust her back.
qualityNotes: The clearest hands-on correction in the Prabhava set - the teacher's arm is extended to the student's back and the intent is unmistakable. Sharp. The mirror behind repeats both figures and a red bolster sits on the floor at the right.

alt: A woman with one hand on her hip and one on a chair while three practitioners work behind her
subject: A woman in a dark brown top stands with one hand on her hip and one on a chair while three practitioners work behind her, a pink door and a 'YOGA HALL' sign at the far end.
qualityNotes: The strongest class frame on the sheet: four figures stepping back in depth, all in the same pose, sharp, with daylight from the left. The pink door at the end is a loud colour accident.

alt: A person in a supported headstand over a folding chair beneath a window with green leaves outside
subject: A person in a pink top holds a supported headstand over a folding chair against a yellow wall, beneath a window with blue curtains and green leaves outside.
qualityNotes: The best single-figure inversion in the archive: one person, warm yellow wall, real daylight and foliage through the window. An empty black chair and a red bag sit at the right and would need cropping.

alt: A narrow earth lane between a white building and a wall of hanging vines, opening into light
subject: A narrow earth lane runs between a white rendered building on the right and a wall of hanging vines and trees on the left, opening into light at the far end.
qualityNotes: Strong, quiet composition with a natural tunnel of vines and a clean white wall to hold type against. Deep shadow on the left is close to blocking up, and the far end is blown.

alt: A row of prepared practice places with mats, blankets, bolsters, blocks and chairs on a red floor
subject: A row of prepared practice places on a red floor - mats, folded blankets, patterned bolsters, wooden blocks and folding chairs - receding towards a white wall and green netting.
qualityNotes: The clearest of the prepared-room set: props sharply rendered, good depth, a calm white wall across the top third for type. Red floor still dominant; a doorway at the top right is bright.

alt: A woman addressing five women seated on a red floor beside a whiteboard on an easel
subject: A woman stands at the left addressing five women seated on the red floor of a wide hall, with a whiteboard on an easel at the right and green netting across the back.
qualityNotes: A clean small-group teaching frame with plenty of breathing space and a real sense of the hall. Flat midday light, and the wide empty floor leaves the figures small.

alt: A woman in a printed sari standing with one arm extended beside a whiteboard on an easel
subject: A woman in a black and white printed sari stands with one arm extended beside a whiteboard on an easel in an otherwise empty hall.
qualityNotes: The only clean single-teacher frame in the TTC set: one figure, a whiteboard, a huge quiet white wall, and a strong gesture. The handwritten heading on the whiteboard is legible at full size and must be read and cleared before publication. Her face is fully identifiable.

alt: A line of people with legs raised over folding chairs seen from the foot of the row
subject: A line of people lie with their legs raised over folding chairs along a dark red floor, seen from the foot of the row so the chairs and raised legs stack into a receding pattern.
qualityNotes: Unusually graphic - from this angle the row reads as pure rhythm and no face is visible, which makes it easy to publish. Darker and moodier than the rest of the set. A discarded bag sits in the mid-ground.

alt: A discussion circle in an open pavilion with several people writing in notebooks as one speaks
subject: A discussion circle in the open pavilion with several people writing in notebooks, one woman gesturing as she speaks, daylight and trees beyond the columns.
qualityNotes: The clearest 'people studying' frame in the archive - notebooks open, someone mid-sentence, the rest listening. The foreground head is still present but smaller than in cell 10. Bright background beyond the columns.

alt: Three women seated on chairs listening, one resting her chin on her hand, another holding a notebook
subject: Three women sit on plastic chairs in the open pavilion, one resting her chin on her hand listening, another holding a notebook and pen, with a wooden ledge and trees behind.
qualityNotes: The single best 'attention' frame in the archive: three people genuinely listening, one with her chin on her hand, notebooks in laps. Natural side light. Their faces are fully identifiable and a bag strap cuts across the foreground.

alt: A man sitting cross-legged on a stone slab beneath a banyan, a low brick wall and fields behind
subject: A man sits cross-legged with hands in his lap on a stone slab beneath the banyan, seen in landscape with a low red brick wall and fields behind.
qualityNotes: The only landscape-format frame of the seated figure, so the one that can run as a wide banner. The red brick wall behind is an unattractive band and the figure sits dead centre.

alt: Five women sitting cross-legged on grass with hands on knees beneath tall trees
subject: Five women sit cross-legged on grass with hands on knees beneath tall trees, a low white building visible beyond the hedge.
qualityNotes: Wider framing that gives the trees their full height above the group - the best balance of figures to setting in this run. The hose is still visible and the building beyond is a slight distraction.

alt: A woman sitting cross-legged on grass with her eyes closed and hands on her knees, four others seated behind
subject: A woman in a blue vest sits cross-legged on grass in the foreground with her hands resting on her knees and eyes closed, four others seated behind her among the trees.
qualityNotes: The strongest single frame on the sheet: one clear foreground subject with her eyes closed, the group receding behind her, soft light and an uncluttered green background. Her face is fully identifiable and a tattoo is visible on her arm.

alt: Four women hanging inverted from wall ropes in a row along a white wall
subject: Four women hang inverted from wall ropes in a row along a white wall, hands towards the red floor, with folding chairs beside them.
qualityNotes: Four suspended figures in a row make a genuinely arresting rhythm, and the red floor against the white wall is a strong colour pairing. Sharpest of the rope frames. Green netting visible at the right.

alt: A woman and a man standing in warrior two with arms extended in front of an arched window
subject: A woman in white and a man in a red t-shirt stand in warrior two with arms extended, facing each other across their mats in front of a blue-curtained arched window.
qualityNotes: The strongest frame of this run: two clear figures, symmetrical arms, good window light behind. A bare foot and a block intrude at the bottom edge and a rolled cloth sits on the floor; a tight crop fixes both.

alt: A woman folding forward with her foot on a wooden block and a stick laid along the mat
subject: A woman folds forward over a straight front leg with her foot on a wooden block and a measuring stick across the mat, a second practitioner doing the same behind her.
qualityNotes: The clearest illustration of prop-measured alignment in this run. Sharp, well lit, and the top third of the frame is a quiet pale wall. A walking figure in the background is cut mid-stride.

alt: A person in supported shoulderstand with feet against a wall while a woman in a white coat watches
subject: A person in a red top and dark trousers holds supported shoulderstand over a chair, feet against the wall, while a woman in a white coat looks on from the right; a small household shrine with a lamp stands behind.
qualityNotes: Good separation of the figure against a plain wall and strong window light. The shrine and the white-coated observer read as a clinical or therapy setting rather than a studio, which may or may not be wanted. Sharp.

alt: A man in supported shoulderstand in the foreground while a teacher bends over a student behind him
subject: A man in a red t-shirt holds supported shoulderstand in the foreground with three others behind him along the wall, while a man in a yellow kurta bends over a student in the background.
qualityNotes: The most complete story on the sheet: a foreground practitioner, a receding line of the same pose, and a teacher actively working in the background. Slight warm cast and a doorway that draws the eye at the centre.

alt: Five people in supported shoulderstand receding down a hall, the nearest reaching towards a block
subject: Five people in supported shoulderstand recede down the hall, the nearest lying on a white blanket with arms stretched towards a block.
qualityNotes: Best-lit frame of the sixteen and the cleanest floor, with the strongest sense of depth. Still a repeat of the same idea; one of this run is enough.

alt: A man holding a deep side lunge with a hand on his hip on a dark mat
subject: A man in an orange t-shirt holds a deep side lunge with a hand on his hip on a dark mat, prop shelves and a blue-curtained window behind.
qualityNotes: Strong single figure, sharp, good separation from the wall. A bare arm and shoulder of another practitioner intrudes at the right edge and would need cropping out.

alt: Three people in supported shoulderstand against a yellow wall with daylight from an open window
subject: Three people in supported shoulderstand against a yellow wall seen from further back, with an open window and daylight at the right and a pink bolster in the foreground.
qualityNotes: Best light on the sheet - real daylight from the window warming the yellow wall. Weakened by a large empty foreground and a pink bolster dumped at the bottom left.

alt: A person in a supported headstand between two chairs with arms spread along the seats
subject: A person in olive trousers holds a supported headstand between two chairs, arms spread wide along the chair seats, on a pale tiled floor.
qualityNotes: The strongest of the headstand run - the spread arms make a wide stable base and the vertical legs a clean line. The practitioner's t-shirt carries legible printed text that reads mirrored in this orientation, which would need checking before it ships large.

alt: A line of people folding forward over chairs while a teacher adjusts the hands of one at the far end
subject: The same line of chair-supported forward bends with a teacher in a pale green kurta standing at the far end adjusting a practitioner's hands.
qualityNotes: Better than cell 13 because the teacher at the end turns a row of shapes into a taught class. Sharp throughout. The teacher is small in the frame and partly cut by the right edge.

alt: A woman in a printed sari standing with both arms spread wide beside a whiteboard
subject: A woman in a printed sari stands with both arms spread wide beside a whiteboard on a red floor in front of a plain wall.
qualityNotes: The open-armed gesture is the strongest of the four teaching frames, and the empty wall above is very clean. Same whiteboard problem: heading and year legible. Her face is fully identifiable.

alt: A woman in a printed sari kneeling with both arms crossed above her head, fingers spread
subject: A woman in a printed sari kneels on a red floor with both arms crossed above her head, fingers spread, a whiteboard behind her.
qualityNotes: The sharpest and most striking of the four - kneeling, arms crossed overhead, clearly demonstrating a shape. The whiteboard is closer here and more legible, so cropping is essential. Face fully identifiable.

alt: Three people in supported shoulderstand over chairs against a white wall
subject: Three people hold supported shoulderstand over chairs against a white wall, seen in portrait with mats and blocks on the red floor below.
qualityNotes: A rare portrait-format frame of the inversion row, useful for a tall slot. Clean white wall, no readable faces. The floor in the foreground is a large empty red area.

alt: A man sitting cross-legged with his hands in his lap on a stone slab at the foot of a huge banyan tree
subject: A man in a dark kurta and cream trousers sits cross-legged with his hands in his lap on a stone slab at the foot of a huge banyan tree, hanging roots and green foliage above him.
qualityNotes: The most atmospheric single-figure frame in the archive - a still seated figure beneath a banyan, nobody else in shot, no branding, no clutter. Overcast light keeps it even. The sky at the right is blown and a red wall edge intrudes at the right; both crop out easily.

alt: A man sitting cross-legged on a stone slab under a banyan tree, the trunk rising above him
subject: A man sits cross-legged on a stone slab under the banyan, seen in portrait format with the trunk and roots rising above him and fields beyond.
qualityNotes: Portrait version, which gives the tree its full height and leaves a large quiet area of trunk above the figure - the best text headroom of any peopled frame in the archive. A telegraph pole and a bright field at the right are minor distractions.

alt: A paved path running away between tall slender tree trunks under a green canopy
subject: A paved path runs away between tall slender tree trunks and planted beds, with a distant figure at the far end under a green canopy.
qualityNotes: Tall format with a strong vanishing point and a dense green canopy - a good vertical transition image. The tiny distant figure gives scale without being identifiable. Slightly flat and grey overall.

alt: A woman sitting cross-legged on grass with both arms raised overhead, another practitioner behind
subject: A woman in a pale blue t-shirt sits cross-legged on grass with both arms raised overhead, another practitioner behind her among the trees.
qualityNotes: Portrait format with a clear single subject and good green above - useful for a tall slot. She is smiling at the camera, and a banana plant at the top right is a slightly awkward shape.

alt: Two women hanging inverted from wall ropes, the roof beams and anchors visible above
subject: Two women hang inverted from wall ropes against a white wall, seen in portrait with the roof beams and rope anchors above.
qualityNotes: Portrait framing shows the full height of the ropes from anchor to floor, which explains the apparatus better than cell 13. Slightly soft and the wall is uneven.

alt: Brass wind chime tubes hanging beside a pillar above a white parapet with two potted plants
subject: Long brass wind chime tubes hang beside a terracotta pillar over a white parapet holding two small potted plants, with dense green trees behind.
qualityNotes: One of only two quiet atmospheric frames in the entire Prabhava set, and genuinely useful as a section transition. Soft even daylight, no people, no branding. The parapet is a little stained and the composition is slightly top-heavy.

alt: Brass wind chimes and a wooden striker disc hanging above a white parapet with trees behind
subject: The same wind chimes with the wooden striker disc hanging clear against the white parapet and green trees beyond.
qualityNotes: Better separated than cell 5, with the striker disc reading clearly and more of the green mass behind. Large calm areas at the lower left and lower right for type. Slightly flat contrast.

alt: A printed sheet of circular blue stickers each carrying a white calligraphic mark
subject: A printed sheet of fifteen circular stickers, each a blue disc carrying a white calligraphic mark, held flat against a surface by a hand at the top right.
qualityNotes: Genuinely graphic - a clean repeating grid of the institution's own mark on white, sharp and evenly lit. A thumb and finger intrude at the top right. Usable as an abstract texture or a section divider if the hand is cropped out.

alt: Two painted circular tree seats under spreading trees on open sandy ground
subject: Two painted circular tree seats under spreading trees on sandy open ground, with a low building visible through the trunks.
qualityNotes: Same subject as cell 3, framed wider so the two painted rings balance each other. Strong dappled light and deep shade; the exposure holds both. Useful as a transition frame.

alt: A coconut palm crown seen from below with clusters of green coconuts among the fronds
subject: A coconut palm crown seen from below, with clusters of green coconuts against fronds and a bright sky.
qualityNotes: Sharp, graphic and completely unpeopled - a useful abstract texture or section break. The sky behind is blown to white in patches and the greens are a little acid.

alt: A close view along a row of mats with folded blankets, bolsters, blocks and folding chairs
subject: A close view along a row of prepared mats with folded black blankets, patterned bolsters, wooden blocks and folding chairs on a red oxide floor.
qualityNotes: The tightest and most abstract of the five - close enough that the props read as pattern rather than furniture. Good as a texture panel. Plain white wall above gives clean space, though the frame is a little static.

alt: An empty row of folding chairs, mats, blankets, bolsters and wooden blocks on a red floor
subject: An empty row of prepared practice places on a red oxide floor: folding chairs, mats, folded black blankets, patterned bolsters and pairs of wooden blocks.
qualityNotes: Another prepared-room frame, this one closer and more abstract than the TTC-03 set - the wooden blocks in the foreground are the strongest element. Sharp and quiet. The red floor dominates and the white wall above is empty but slightly grey.
